steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Reporting in—from the Hour of Yu yesterday to the Hour of Yin today, we have moved more than eighty percent of the residents from the area around the main street to nomadic plate C.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Some residents remain due to official duties, property concerns, or other reasons.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Sentry Officer
steps.text: Urge them to settle their affairs at once and leave material goods behind. Time is almost up.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Sentry Officer
steps.text: Also, strengthen security inspections at checkpoints. Report any suspicious individuals or situations to your captain immediately.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So Baizao's already evacuating the population... I wonder if the Sui Regulator has any news from the Tomb of Sui.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: That's a lot of sentries... best not draw attention to myself.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Time for a detour.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: That's—
Zuo Le goes around the checkpoint, but as he turns a corner, he spots someone who should not be there.

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: Zuo Le.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Are you...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Apologies, but may I ask... who you are, sir?

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: The Sui Regulator is aware of your deeds at Mangshan Town and in the Garden of Grotesqueries. I was dispatched to meet you here. You've done well.

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: You must be exhausted. Go to rest.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Thank you for your concern.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But I have to deliver a token to the Sui Regulator, and share the details of the Placation with the Supervisor at once, so I dare not retire for now.

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: Just the proof of the Placation. Fret not, just hand it here and I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: As for the report, you may submit it at a later time.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But...
Zuo Le subconsciously rubs the token in his pocket with his knuckles.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is a special case, so I must submit the token and my report to the Supervisor myself.

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: Still doubting me, when I have the approval penned personally by the Supervisor for my actions right here?

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: Zuo Le, I know you are very conscientious, but the situation is complicated. You need not be stubborn.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm sorry, sir... but this is all too sudden, and I don't know where this change is coming from.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I do not doubt the Supervisor's orders, but could we at least head over to the Sui Regulator together so I can get a complete grasp of the situation?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Sir... what is the meaning of this?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Is someone obstructing official duties here?

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: Stay your hand... for now.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I've never seen the Sui Regulator cooperate with the Patrol Battalion before.

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: As I said, things are complicated. This is how affairs are handled in wartime.

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: Zuo Le, tarry any longer and we may hinder our battle plans.

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: I'm acting on orders. If you have any further questions, save them for the Supervisor herself later.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: 'Acting on orders'... dare I ask whose orders these are?

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: That is classified military information that may not be leaked, Lord Zuo. I'm sure you understand, seeing as you grew up in the barracks.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Three hundred Candleholders in the Sui Regulator, and none know each other's past.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So, how do you know my background?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Just who are you?

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: Seize him.
Go!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: What—?
A black sphere suddenly rolls down to the center of their stalemate, spewing out thick black smoke that spreads quickly through the air.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: An ambush! Assume defensive positions!
Just run already!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Wha—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Ah!
Zuo Le jumps up onto the eaves, mid-exclamation.

steps.name: Masked Candleholder
steps.text: After him!
Footsteps rumble behind the young man as several soldiers rush in his direction.

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Form a line! There's still time, no need to rush!

steps.name: Diligent Student
steps.text: Think carefully. Did you leave it at your desk?

steps.name: Panicked Student
steps.text: Y-Yeah! Probably!

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Panicked Student
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Panicked Student
steps.text: We finished an experiment outside the city, and only just the evacuation order...

steps.name: Diligent Student
steps.text: But we left something important in the school laboratory. We'll be back once we've fetched it, I promise! Can we go?

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Time isn't on our side, what could be so important...?

steps.name: Diligent Student
steps.text: It's really important data! We spent years just to collect it!

steps.name: Diligent Student
steps.text: If we can iron out the issue, then maybe... just maybe...

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Show me your student card, and then go over there for a security inspection.

steps.name: Diligent Student & Panicked Student
steps.text: Thank you, sir!

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Right, once you get the data, evacuate with the Academy's staff. Make sure you leave within twenty-four hours.

steps.name: Diligent Student & Panicked Student
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Hold it there, girl!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Young lady, Baizao is undergoing a mass evacuation. There is no entrance to the city without special permission.

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: May I ask what brings you here?
Ch'en tries to blend in with those entering the city, but the keen-eyed guard spots her immediately, and approaches.
She makes sure Chi Xiao stays unseen behind her.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm... looking for my uncle.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: He's old, has trouble walking, and brought a lot of luggage on this trip—so my aunt asked me to escort him out.

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Hm? But when the Ministry of Revenue issued the evacuation order two days ago, they brought out every elderly resident.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: My uncle isn't a local... He's a tourist from Lungmen, who came here for Mid-Autumn.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: He's... kind of a loner, and rarely talks to people. He's spent the last two days waiting for me to come pick him up at the inn.

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Your papers, please...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Sure.

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Lungmenite... Ch'en Hui-chieh... former Senior Superintendent of the L.G.D.

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: And you're... an Infected?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I retired from the force because of it, but that was so long ago...

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Thank you for your service. You may go.

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: If you don't manage to find your uncle, seek the nearest guard for help.

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: But make sure you leave the city within twenty-four hours.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Thanks for the heads up.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Right, could I just ask... Have you seen a tall Lung with red hair and horns pass through here since yesterday?

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: But the description is somewhat familiar...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't worry about it. Just a passing thought.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Duoxie. I'll be going now.

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Wait, miss! Where are you headed—

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: A muster signal?!

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: What's happening over there?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Sentry Officer
steps.text: Retreat! Everyone, run! Take cover!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Sentry Officer
steps.text: Attention all units—ensure civilians inside the sentry posts are safe!

steps.name: Nervous Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: O-Over there... what's that black mass?
In the dark of night, as thick clouds shroud the moonlight's glow, an 'army' descends upon the streets.
No commands, no war drums, no rattling of weapons against armor—even their approach makes no sound.
A disciplined, formidable, but still indistinct battalion closes in on the checkpoint with a deathly silence.

steps.name: Nervous Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Hey... did you hear about the ghosts in Baizao... before the city moved onto a nomadic plate...?

steps.name: Nervous Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: A ghost army...

steps.name: Vigilant Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: You believe in folk tales too? Probably a mirage caused by the strange weather lately!

steps.name: Nervous Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: It's way too realistic to be a mirage...

steps.name: Nervous Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: No, look at their armor! It's totally different from ours!

steps.name: Nervous Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: That's no mirage—

The army closes in, and the guard finally gets a clear look at the moving mass. Silent soldiers bear blurry, yet terrifying faces with old, bloodstained armor, like evil spirits from thousands of years ago.
A soldier's spear point nears the guard's neck before he can even react.
Fall back!

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: A shadow?
The Imperial Guard apprentice slashes forward, but merely changes the spear's trajectory, while the immense strength hidden in the soldier's attack startles her.
The spear point sweeps above her head, but the weapon unnaturally whips backwards, heading for her vitals.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: There's nothing inside—
The soldier is destroyed by her slash.
Strangely, the other soldiers do not treat her as a foe, and simply advance along the empty road silently with no discernible destination.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Sentry Officer
steps.text: Captain!

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Send word to the other barracks: these soldiers are anomalous enemies; exercise extreme caution against them.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: They don't seem to be actively hostile, so don't initiate conflict.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Evacuate anyone along the way and be on guard for developments.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Sentry Officer
steps.text: Captain, where did they come from? What even are they...?

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: ...Geists.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Dispatch some men to update the Sui Regulator at once.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: They're merely marching forward for now, but we cannot allow them to endanger civilians or trespass into restricted areas.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Sentry Officer
steps.text: At once!

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: I fear this unrest indicates whatever's happening inside the Tomb of Sui must be quelled immediately.

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Could His Majesty's decree actually be...

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: Are they... already fighting?

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: A crimson sword flash?

steps.name: Panicked Crowd
steps.text: My goodness... where did this army come from?!

steps.name: Panicked Crowd
steps.text: Th-They're headed our way! Help!

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: 'Scriptgeists'....

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: Still the same old look. Whose ancient dwelling dream is this?

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: Is it because It woke up? Or because you've returned home?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you alright, madam—

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: How can I ever repay you?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What? No, there's no need for that...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't know where these creatures crawled out of, but they're dangerous. Just be careful.
Ch'en notices the woman calmly ignoring the surrounding commotion. She even turns to look at Ch'en herself.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Um...
Noticing the woman's scrutinizing gaze, Ch'en immediately sheathes Chi Xiao—in vain.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: A descendant of the House of Yan.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You must have misunderstood, I—

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: What say you—what's the difference between forcing one person's will upon the masses, and enlightening the masses with the insight of one mind?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where's this question coming from?

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: You do not have an answer now?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This isn't the best time to discuss it.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: What a shame.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: Perhaps we can continue our conversation another time.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: ...Perhaps.
The woman does not wait for Ch'en to respond before melting back into the crowd.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Strange lady.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Actually, are these monsters that popped up out of nowhere... related to the 'bestial Sui'?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They seem to be coming from the same direction—
The Patrol Battalion flashes across his view as Zuo Le hides behind a wall.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What's going on inside the city...? Whose orders are they following? And why are they so fixated on this token from the Garden?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: That approval letter was indeed written in the Supervisor's own hand... but why would she be working with them—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: More troops?!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No, that's... that's?!
Countless paintings flash through his mind, until it stops on a scroll depicting the Great Hunt in the Sui Regulator's hidden collection.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I recall a similar scroll in Father's study.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Could they be... geists?!
As he stays deep in thought, the leading geist suddenly rushes towards him.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Look out!
The black geist disperses, leaving splotches of black ink on the nearby walls.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (This inkstain... a scriptgeist?!)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (But how? Don't tell me, that vanished proxy...)

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: My Lord! Are you—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Pester me any longer and I shan't show you mercy!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Th-There's a misunderstanding, sir!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: I saw you getting attacked by that monster, so I ran here to help...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're not apprehending me?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: My Lord must be joking... I only just received orders to assist the Candleholders in cleansing the monsters...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Have you seen any other Candleholders?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: N-No.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (The city is in turmoil, but the Sui Regulator hasn't sent anyone...)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (And the Patrol Battalion... obviously two different directives have been issued...)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (I must get to the bottom of this, once I meet with the Supervisor.)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: My apologies... this was my mistake. Please excuse me.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's dangerous here. Keep safe.
His sword flashes in a spin as Zuo Le dispatches several nearby geists, and he instantly vanishes into an alley.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Guard
steps.text: S-So fast!
Gah... why the rush?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: More and more scriptgeists this way...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Where exactly did they come from...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: —Come out!

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Alright, alright... Here I am, don't get mad now.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's you—!

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You, girl, you're coming with me.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You don't get along with that Candleholder boy, and you'll just keep fighting in there. Whatever you're looking for, he can find it for you.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And what is your intention, having followed me the whole way?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Why the attitude? Shouldn't you be happy, reuniting with an acquaintance?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I believe the Old Tianshi has her reasons for letting you go.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But I can't trust you... a Shanhaizhong.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Fine, fine... O righteous and benevolent Lord Zuo of the Sui Regulator, I know you look down upon us lot.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: But you're being hunted down by your own people. Surely we can cooperate a little?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I believe there's been a misunderstanding... I'll go to see the Supervisor, and from there, I will naturally—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Hold on, how do you know the Sui Regulator is after me?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: You numbskull! They would be walking you back right now, if I hadn't stepped in when they were surrounding you back there!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Wait, that was you—

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Duh! Who else would dare get in the Sui Regulator's way?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: I saved your life, so could you be just a bit nicer, maybe?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: There are geists in the vicinity, miss—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So you should be careful.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Damn it... these blasted things are crawling everywhere. Situation's even worse than I thought.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Enough nonsense. Where's the thing you got from the Garden?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What...? You want it too?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm not telling you.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Hey—

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Huff...!
She turns around, pointing towards the growing mass of scriptgeists, accumulating from all directions.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Ignore me, and you'd better have a way to deal with all of that.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: You know how to use that token?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I... do not.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Then just zip it and hand it over!
After a momentary reluctance, Zuo Le finally takes out the 'doll' he took so much care to keep on himself.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: This color... it really is her.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Where did you get it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In a study, or was it a memorial hall?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I can't recall... I don't know why, but our memories of the Garden are a mess.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I have a question, though. Is this object, as you say, able to stop Yan and the bestial Sui from going to war?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: I'll tell you later. For now, we're going to use it to take care of these ugly things!
Mo Yi unceremoniously snatches the token from him.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Hey—!

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: All to break the stalemate—the only way out.
The girl leaps forward, putting distance between her and Zuo Le.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (—The forbidden Arts from that day!)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Wait, you can't do that inside the city—

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: With ink flowing as years roll on, annals are wrought; through spring and autumn's turns, the tale of countless lives is told—

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: In the name of the Shanhaizhong, I beseech thee: Fifth of the Twelve, bearing the name Jie—manifest!
She holds the token with a stern expression, and recites her chant—
But it seems... as if nothing is happening?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Huh... so that's not how you use it.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: My guess was off...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Oh well, works for me.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Let me borrow this for a bit. I'll give it back once I'm done studying it.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Wait! You're not going anywhere!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The geists vanished with the sunrise.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They were all coming from here. So this must be the source.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The Sky Mirror Pavilion... this is the place?

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Stop right there!
